native.scope: Full fresh upstream composition plus finite-search candidate. Final panel/table formatting revision followed this run; numerical core and native tests unchanged, final actual browser rerun passed.
native.sourceMaterialization: Pinned Git blobs, with an explicitly local receiving Git snapshot for an inherited CLI test requiring git rev-parse. Earlier missing evaluation/example/NOAA files were supplied; the local snapshot is not represented as an upstream commit.

focused.scope: Analytical inverse, every grid pair against maintained solver, endpoint ambiguity, dry/nonidentifiable, held-aside isolation, refusals, explicit selection, replay and aggregate bounds.

browser.keyboard: Actual visible keyboard search/select/prepare/comparison/download, native file reopen, ArrowRight local table scrolling.

review: Independent optimizer review accepted numerical/holdout/replay contract and separately proved final panel was only scientific-format and table-layout additions. Lead inspected actual desktop/mobile source/search views.
limits: Finite grid agreement is not a continuous inverse solution, unique soil property or field accuracy.
Held-aside readings are reported and cannot rank or select calibration alternatives.
Explicit selection copies tested hypotheses into a comparison draft; it does not adopt materials.
Reopened saved searches are independent of the working source and cannot prepare its draft.
